repos.description: A Simple and Universal Swarm Intelligence Engine, Predicting Anything. 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物
repos.summary_zh: MiroFish 是一款基于多智能体技术的群体智能预测引擎，通过构建高保真数字沙盘模拟现实世界演化。用户上传种子数据（如新闻、小说）并描述预测需求，系统自动生成智能体进行社会推演，最终输出详尽预测报告，适用于舆情分析、文学创作等场景。
repos.summary_en: MiroFish is a swarm intelligence prediction engine powered by multi-agent technology. It builds high-fidelity digital simulations from seed data (e.g., news, novels) and uses autonomous agents to simulate societal evolution. Users input natural language queries to receive detailed forecasts and interact with the simulated world, enabling applications in舆情预测, creative writing, and strategic planning.

repos.description: 小红书笔记 | 评论爬虫、抖音视频 | 评论爬虫、快手视频 | 评论爬虫、B 站视频 ｜ 评论爬虫、微博帖子 ｜ 评论爬虫、百度贴吧帖子 ｜ 百度贴吧评论回复爬虫  | 知乎问答文章｜评论爬虫
repos.summary_zh: MediaCrawler 是一个基于 Playwright 的多平台自媒体数据采集工具，支持小红书、抖音、B站等7大主流平台的公开内容抓取，具备关键词搜索、评论爬取、登录态缓存、IP代理池及词云图生成等功能，无需复杂逆向即可高效采集数据。
repos.summary_en: MediaCrawler is a powerful multi-platform media crawler built with Playwright, supporting data extraction from Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, and 7+ platforms. It enables keyword search, comment scraping, login state caching, proxy pools, and comment word cloud generation without requiring complex reverse engineering.

repos.description: 抖音 / TikTok 平台作品下载/数据采集工具
repos.summary_zh: DouK-Downloader 是一款基于 Python 和 HTTPX 的免费开源数据采集工具，支持批量下载抖音/TikTok 视频、图集、直播、合集及评论数据。具备 Web UI、API 接口、多线程下载、代理支持、增量采集、文件断点续传等功能，可部署至私有或公开服务器，适用于内容创作者、数据分析师等场景。
repos.summary_en: DouK-Downloader is a free open-source data collection tool built with Python and HTTPX, enabling batch downloads of videos, albums, live streams, collections, and comments from Douyin/TikTok. It features Web UI, API interface, multi-threaded downloads, proxy support, incremental scraping, and resume capability, deployable on private or public servers for content creators and data analysts.

repos.description: MCP for xiaohongshu.com
repos.summary_zh: 小红书 MCP 是一个专为 xiaohongshu.com 设计的自动化工具，支持登录验证、图文/视频内容发布、内容搜索、推荐列表获取、帖子详情抓取、评论互动及用户主页信息提取。采用本地路径优先的图片处理机制，确保上传稳定性，并提供完整的 HTTP API 与 MCP 工具调用支持，适用于内容运营与数据采集场景。
repos.summary_en: Xiaohongshu MCP is an automation tool designed for xiaohongshu.com, supporting login verification, publishing text/image and video content, searching posts, fetching recommended feeds, retrieving post details with interactions, commenting, and user profile data extraction. It prioritizes local file paths for media uploads to ensure stability, and offers full HTTP API and MCP tool integration for content operations and data collection.

repos.description: 小红书（XiaoHongShu、RedNote）链接提取/作品采集工具
repos.summary_zh: XHS-Downloader 是一款功能强大的小红书（XiaoHongShu/RedNote）作品采集与下载工具，支持提取账号作品、收藏、点赞链接，采集作品信息及下载地址，批量下载图文、视频、LivePhoto 文件，具备断点续传、文件完整性校验、自定义命名格式、剪贴板监听、MCP 调用等高级功能，适用于内容创作者与数据收集场景。
repos.summary_en: XHS-Downloader is a powerful tool for extracting and downloading content from Xiaohongshu (XHS/RedNote). It supports fetching posts, likes, collections, and albums, downloading media files (images, videos, LivePhotos), with features like resume downloads, file integrity checks, custom naming, clipboard monitoring, and MCP integration, ideal for content creators and data collectors.

repos.description: A practical Douyin downloader for both single-item and profile batch downloads, with progress display, retries, SQLite deduplication, and browser fallback support. 抖音批量下载工具，去水印，支持视频、图集、合集、音乐(原声)。
repos.summary_zh: 抖音批量下载工具，支持视频、图集、合集、音乐及主页作品去水印下载。具备进度显示、自动重试、SQLite去重、完整性校验及浏览器兜底抓取功能，并提供跨平台桌面端应用（支持抖音、TikTok、YouTube），实现多链接队列与账号内容同步。
repos.summary_en: A practical Douyin batch downloader supporting watermark-free downloads of videos, galleries, collections, and music. Features progress display, auto-retry, SQLite deduplication, integrity checks, and browser fallback. Includes a cross-platform desktop app for Douyin, TikTok, and YouTube with multi-link queuing and account sync.

repos.description: 🪧 Claude Code / Codex skill — generate Xiaohongshu carousels & WeChat 21:9+1:1 cover pairs. Editorial × Swiss visual systems, 28 layouts, 10 themes, single-file HTML → PNG. 小红书图文 + 公众号封面对
repos.summary_zh: Guizang Social Card Skill 是一款面向 Claude Code / Codex 等 AI Agent 的图文卡片生成技能，专为小红书图文与公众号封面设计。内置 Editorial 与 Swiss 两套视觉系统，提供 28 种版式与 10 套主题，支持单文件 HTML 转 PNG，无需前端构建，自动适配多尺寸输出，集成图片搜索、地图组件与校验脚本，提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Guizang Social Card Skill is an AI agent skill for Claude Code/Codex that generates Xiaohongshu carousels and WeChat cover pairs. It features Editorial and Swiss visual systems with 28 layouts and 10 themes, converting single-file HTML to PNG without build tools. Includes image sourcing, map components, and validation scripts for streamlined social content creation.

repos.description: Red Ink - A one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator based on the 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, "One Sentence, One Image: Generate Xiaohongshu Text and Images."
repos.summary_zh: 红墨是基于🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌的一站式小红书图文生成器，支持一句话生成完整图文内容，包含智能大纲、封面页和内容页批量生成。采用Python Flask后端与Vue 3前端，支持Docker一键部署，集成Gemini 3文案与图片生成能力，提供可视化配置界面。
repos.summary_en: RedInk is a one-stop Xiaohongshu image-and-text generator powered by 🍌Nano Banana Pro🍌, enabling instant creation of complete posts from a single sentence. It features AI-driven outline generation, cover page design, and batch content creation. Built with Python Flask backend and Vue 3 frontend, it supports Docker deployment and integrates Gemini 3 for text and image generation with a user-friendly web interface.

repos.description: A jQuery UI theme based on Twitter Bootstrap
repos.summary_zh: jQuery UI Bootstrap 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap 设计的 jQuery UI 主题，旨在让 jQuery UI 组件与 Bootstrap 风格无缝融合。它支持与 Bootstrap 共存，并提供现代化外观，同时兼容 jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3 及现代浏览器。项目处于活跃开发中，目标是实现 Bootstrap 3.x 兼容性，欢迎社区贡献。
repos.summary_en: jQuery UI Bootstrap is a theme for jQuery UI widgets inspired by Twitter Bootstrap's design, enabling visual consistency between Bootstrap and jQuery UI components. It supports coexistence with Bootstrap CSS and targets jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3. The project is actively developed with goals to achieve Bootstrap 3.x compatibility and welcomes contributors.

repos.description: Wrappers for JavaScript alert(), confirm() and other flexible dialogs using Twitter's bootstrap framework
repos.summary_zh: Bootbox 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap 框架的 JavaScript 对话框封装库，提供简洁易用的 alert()、confirm() 等弹窗接口，支持高度定制化与响应式设计，适用于现代 Web 应用的用户交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootbox is a JavaScript library that wraps native alert(), confirm(), and other dialog functions using Twitter's Bootstrap framework, offering customizable, responsive modal dialogs for modern web applications.

repos.description: 手绘风格编号画廊与双语提示词 Skill
repos.summary_zh: 整合324种手绘风格、161种排版图型与36种主题色的AI生图提示词库。通过编号精准控制画风与构图，支持智能推荐与精准指定双模式，一键生成中英双语提示词，适配小红书、公众号、条漫等多场景创作。
repos.summary_en: A curated AI image generation prompt library featuring 324 hand-drawn styles, 161 layout templates, and 36 classic color themes. Generate precise bilingual prompts through numbered style codes with smart recommendation and precise selection modes, ideal for social media content, comics, and visual design.

repos.description: 查看被删的微信好友
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过微信网页版接口检测被删除好友，原理为新建群组测试好友是否可添加。因接口存在人数限制及微信策略变更，已无法正常使用。推荐替代方案包括网页版微信API及Electron桌面客户端，支持Python、Go、Node.js等多语言实现。
repos.summary_en: This project detects WeChat users who deleted you by creating group tests via the web interface. It is now unusable due to API rate limits and policy changes. Alternatives include web-based WeChat APIs and Electron desktop clients, with implementations in Python, Go, and Node.js.

repos.description: Drop-in replacement of Django admin comes with lots of goodies, fully extensible with plugin support, pretty UI based on Twitter Bootstrap.
repos.summary_zh: xadmin 是 Django 管理后台的现代化替代方案，基于 Twitter Bootstrap 提供美观 UI，支持插件扩展、数据导出（XLS/CSV/XML/JSON）、仪表盘、书签等功能，兼容 Django 1.9+，适合快速构建企业级后台管理系统。
repos.summary_en: xadmin is a modern drop-in replacement for Django admin with a Bootstrap-based UI, extensible plugin system, data export (XLS/CSV/XML/JSON), dashboard widgets, and bookmarking. Compatible with Django 1.9+, ideal for building enterprise-grade admin interfaces.

repos.description: 拼多多、千牛、抖店 AI 客服机器人：自动回复客户咨询、商品答疑、售后申诉处理，支持微信、小红书、京东、抖音、B站、微博等多平台统一接待；可接入 DeepSeek / 通义千问 等大模型，支持自有知识库定制。
repos.summary_zh: 金销数据云智能客服是基于大语言模型的专业电商SaaS解决方案，支持微信、拼多多、千牛、抖音、小红书等10+主流平台接入，具备文本/语音/图片处理能力，支持自有知识库定制与插件扩展，提供多维度数据分析与意图识别功能。
repos.summary_en: JinXiao Data Cloud AI Customer Service is a professional e-commerce SaaS solution powered by large language models, supporting integration with 10+ mainstream platforms including WeChat, Pinduoduo, Qianniu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, with capabilities for text/voice/image processing, custom knowledge base configuration, plugin ecosystem, and multi-dimensional data analytics including intent recognition.

repos.description: Quick and easy product tours with Twitter Bootstrap Popovers
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Tour 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap Popovers 的快速易用的产品引导工具，专为构建交互式用户引导流程设计。支持 Bootstrap 2.3.0+ 版本，提供灵活的 API 和丰富的配置选项，适用于提升用户体验和引导新用户。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Tour is a quick and easy product tour library built on Twitter Bootstrap Popovers, designed to create interactive onboarding experiences. Compatible with Bootstrap >= 2.3.0, it offers a flexible API and extensive configuration options for guiding users through applications.

repos.description: Multi-Platform Live Stream Automatic Recording Tool | 多平台直播流自动录制客户端 · 基于FFmpeg · 支持监控/定时/转码
repos.summary_zh: StreamCap 是一款基于 FFmpeg 的多平台直播流自动录制工具，支持 40+ 国内外主流直播平台（如抖音、B站、Twitch、TikTok），具备循环监控、定时录制、批量任务管理和自动转码功能，提供 Windows/macOS/Linux/Web 全平台支持，适用于内容存档与直播数据分析。
repos.summary_en: StreamCap is a multi-platform live stream recording tool powered by FFmpeg and StreamGet, supporting 40+ global platforms (e.g., Douyin, Bilibili, Twitch, TikTok). It features real-time monitoring, scheduled recording, batch processing, and automatic transcoding, with full support for Windows, macOS, Linux, and web deployment for content archiving and live data analysis.

repos.description: An unofficial bilibili client for mac
repos.summary_zh: Bilibili Mac Client 是一款非官方哔哩哔哩桌面客户端，基于 mpv 实现硬解播放与 libass 弹幕渲染，支持多视频网站解析、分段视频拼接、弹幕发送与屏蔽、本地视频播放及自定义配置，显著降低 CPU 占用并优化能效表现。
repos.summary_en: An unofficial Bilibili desktop client for macOS, built on mpv with hardware decoding and libass-based danmaku rendering. It supports multi-site video parsing, segmented video stitching, danmaku interaction, local playback, and extensive customization via mpv config, offering superior performance and energy efficiency compared to HTML5 players.

repos.description: 基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B等系列LLM的针对本地知识库的自动问答
repos.summary_zh: 本项目基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B系列大模型，构建了一个针对本地知识库的自动问答Web应用。支持上传PDF、TXT、DOCX、MD等格式文档，结合多种Embedding模型实现语义检索，提供本地部署和云端体验，适用于私有知识问答、文档理解等场景。
repos.summary_en: This project builds a web-based QA system using LangChain and ChatGLM-6B series LLMs for local knowledge base queries. It supports uploading PDF, TXT, DOCX, MD files and integrates multiple embedding models for semantic retrieval, enabling private, offline document understanding and question answering.

repos.description: Social auth made simple
repos.summary_zh: Python Social Auth 是一个简单易用的社交认证/注册机制库，支持多种框架和第三方认证提供商。基于 django-social-auth 重构，提供统一接口定义新认证源，并扩展对更多框架和 ORM 的支持。该项目已于2016年12月3日停止维护，代码已迁移至 python-social-auth 组织。
repos.summary_en: Python Social Auth is a simple social authentication/registration library supporting multiple frameworks and auth providers. Built on django-social-auth, it offers a unified interface to define third-party authentication providers and extend support for additional frameworks and ORMs. Deprecated since Dec 3, 2016, with code migrated to the python-social-auth organization.

repos.description: Django social authentication made simple
repos.summary_zh: Django Social Auth 是一个为 Django 项目提供社交登录功能的库，支持 Google、Facebook、Twitter 等 40+ 主流平台的 OAuth/OAuth2/OpenID 认证。它基于 python-social-auth 构建，提供用户注册、多账号关联、自定义用户模型和认证管道扩展等核心能力，现已被官方标记为弃用状态。
repos.summary_en: Django Social Auth is a deprecated library enabling social login via OAuth/OAuth2/OpenID for Django projects. It supports 40+ providers including Google, Facebook, and Twitter, offering user registration, multi-account association, custom user models, and extensible authentication pipelines. Now superseded by python-social-auth.

repos.description: 一键将视频转换为优质小红书笔记，自动优化内容和配图
repos.summary_zh: 视频笔记生成器一键将视频内容转换为优质小红书笔记，支持自动语音转文字、AI内容优化、标题创作、配图获取及标签生成。V2.0版本采用FastAPI提供现代化Web界面，支持批量处理、长视频解析、智能错误重试与历史记录管理，显著提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Video Note Generator automatically converts videos into high-quality Xiaohongshu notes with speech-to-text, AI content optimization, title generation, image fetching, and hashtag creation. V2.0 features a modern FastAPI web interface, batch processing, 30-minute video support, smart retry mechanisms, and history tracking for efficient content production.

repos.description: A Django admin theme using Twitter Bootstrap. It doesn't need any kind of modification on your side, just add it to the installed apps.
repos.summary_zh: django-admin-bootstrapped 是一个为 Django 管理后台提供 Twitter Bootstrap 主题的插件，无需修改现有代码即可集成。它支持 Bootstrap 3 样式渲染、可拖拽排序内联表单、自定义 HTML 注入及 XHTML 兼容，显著提升管理界面的视觉体验与交互性。
repos.summary_en: django-admin-bootstrapped is a Django admin theme powered by Twitter Bootstrap, requiring no code changes—just add it to INSTALLED_APPS. It offers Bootstrap 3 styling, drag-and-drop sortable inlines, custom HTML injection, XHTML compatibility, and enhanced message alerts for a modern admin interface.

repos.description: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap.
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Colorpicker 是一个专为 Bootstrap 4 设计的模块化颜色选择插件，支持 jQuery 和 Bootstrap CSS/JS。它提供灵活的颜色选择功能，兼容 v2.x（Bootstrap 3/4）和 v3.x（Bootstrap 4 或无 Bootstrap）版本，适用于网页颜色输入场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap 4, built with jQuery and optional Bootstrap CSS/JS. It supports v2.x (Bootstrap 3/4) and v3.x (Bootstrap 4 or standalone), offering flexible color selection for web applications. Available via npm, yarn, or direct download.

repos.description: 一句话生成大师级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面和各类设计作品。无需懂PS、配色或艺术史，AI自动选择最佳风格（基于20位传奇海报设计师）。支持电影海报、读书笔记、公众号封面、小红书配图等。默认9:16竖版，完美适配社交媒体。包含AI提示词优化、风格对比、图生图转换功能。触发词："Mondo风格"、"书籍封
repos.summary_zh: 乔木Mondo海报设计是一款AI驱动的设计工具，用户只需一句话描述需求，即可自动生成专业级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面等设计作品。基于20位传奇设计师风格库，支持多场景适配（公众号、小红书、电影海报等），内置AI提示词优化与风格对比功能，无需设计基础即可产出大师级作品。
repos.summary_en: Qiaomu Mondo Poster Design is an AI-powered tool that generates professional posters, book covers, and album art from a single sentence. It leverages styles from 20 legendary designers, supports multiple social media formats (WeChat, Xiaohongshu), and includes AI prompt optimization and style comparison features, enabling anyone to create master-level designs without design skills.

repos.description: 归藏的材质插画 skill：生成带字解释图、图表美化和参考辅助配图。
repos.summary_zh: 歸藏的材质插画 Skill 是专为 AI Agent（如 Claude Code/Codex）设计的配图工具，核心解决文章、PPT 及社交卡片中“中心配图”的生成难题。它通过材质化 3D 风格，将抽象概念、数据图表及工作流程转化为带中文标签的解释图、美化图表及参考辅助图，强调信息传达的准确性与视觉的专业性，适配从小红书卡片到教学材料的多种场景。
repos.summary_en: Guizang Material Illustration Skill is an AI Agent-native tool for generating explanatory center graphics. It transforms abstract concepts, data charts, and workflows into labeled 3D material-style illustrations, beautified charts, and reference-assisted visuals. Focusing on information accuracy and Swiss editorial aesthetics, it supports various scenarios from social media cards to educational content.

repos.description: Twitter Bootstrap with Metro style
repos.summary_zh: metro-bootstrap 是基于 Twitter Bootstrap 的 Metro 风格主题，提供现代化的扁平化界面设计，支持通过 npm、Git 或 CDN 快速集成，包含预编译 CSS 和 FontAwesome 字体，适用于快速构建 Windows Metro 风格网页应用。
repos.summary_en: metro-bootstrap is a Metro-styled theme built on Twitter Bootstrap, offering a modern flat UI design. It supports easy integration via npm, Git clone, or CDN, includes precompiled CSS and FontAwesome fonts, ideal for quickly building Windows Metro-style web applications.

repos.description: Use opencli CLI to interact with social/content websites (Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube, Weibo, 小红书, V2EX, Reddit, HackerNews, 雪球, BOSS直聘 etc.)
repos.summary_zh: Qiaomu OpenCLI Skills 是基于 opencli 框架的 Claude Code 技能集合，支持79+网站和桌面应用的CLI化操作，涵盖B站、Twitter、知乎等主流平台的内容获取、发布、下载及浏览器自动化功能，具备智能搜索路由和适配器自动修复能力。
repos.summary_en: Qiaomu OpenCLI Skills is a collection of Claude Code skills built on the opencli framework, enabling CLI operations for 79+ websites and desktop apps. It supports content retrieval, publishing, downloading, and browser automation across platforms like Bilibili, Twitter, Zhihu, with intelligent search routing and auto-repair capabilities.

repos.description: A jQuery tag/token input plugin for Twitter's Bootstrap, by the guys from Sliptree
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Tokenfield 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Twitter Bootstrap 的标签输入插件，支持键盘操作、复制粘贴、自动补全集成等功能。虽然项目已停止维护，但仍可用于需要轻量级标签输入的场景，尤其适合与 Bootstrap 3+ 和 jQuery 1.9+ 配合使用。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Tokenfield is a jQuery plugin for tag/token input built on Twitter Bootstrap, supporting keyboard navigation, copy-paste, and integration with autocomplete/typeahead. Though unmaintained, it remains useful for lightweight tagging in Bootstrap 3+ environments with jQuery 1.9+.

repos.description: Use opencli CLI to interact with social/content websites (Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube, Weibo, 小红书, V2EX, Reddit, HackerNews, 雪球, BOSS直聘 etc.)
repos.summary_zh: opencli-skill 是一个 Claude Code 技能，通过复用 Chrome 登录态直接操控 B站、知乎、Twitter/X、YouTube 等 16 大平台，支持内容浏览、搜索与发布，无需 API Key，实现自然语言驱动的跨平台自动化交互。
repos.summary_en: opencli-skill is a Claude Code skill that enables natural language control over 16 major platforms (e.g., Bilibili, Zhihu, Twitter/X, YouTube) by reusing your Chrome login sessions via opencli CLI—no API keys required—supporting reading, searching, and posting across social and content sites.

repos.description: Python爬虫，返回一定格式的信息，下载，使用flask提供简易api。抖音无水印、皮皮虾、快手、网易云音乐、qq音乐、咪咕音乐、荔枝FM音频、知乎视频、最右语音、视频、微博......
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 Python 的网页爬虫集合，支持抖音、快手、网易云音乐、知乎等平台的无水印视频、音频及内容下载，通过 Flask 提供简易 API 接口。代码风格较旧但功能实用，现计划迁移至 FastAPI 框架重构，适合学习或日常使用。
repos.summary_en: This project is a collection of Python web crawlers for downloading unwatermarked videos, audio, and content from platforms like Douyin, Kuaishou, NetEase Music, and Zhihu. It provides a simple API via Flask. The codebase is outdated but functional, with plans to migrate to FastAPI for better structure and usability.

repos.description: Community fetch recipes for bb-browser — pre-built adapters for Reddit, Twitter, GitHub, and more
repos.summary_zh: bb-sites 是 bb-browser 的社区站点适配器集合，提供 95+ 个预置脚本，将主流平台（如 Reddit、Twitter、GitHub、YouTube、Bilibili 等）转换为 CLI 命令。无需 API 密钥或反爬绕过，直接通过浏览器环境运行，支持搜索、内容抓取、用户交互等场景，实现网页内容的命令行化访问。
repos.summary_en: bb-sites is a community-driven collection of site adapters for bb-browser, enabling websites like Reddit, Twitter, GitHub, and YouTube to be accessed via CLI commands. With 95+ pre-built adapters across 35 platforms, it allows direct content retrieval without API keys or anti-bot workarounds, leveraging the browser's logged-in state for seamless automation.

repos.description: 帮你从文档生成对应的多张配图，内置了歸藏精心探索的图片风格，支持 16:9 和 3:4 两种比例，方便发小红书以及推特。
repos.summary_zh: Document Illustrator 是一款基于 AI 智能分析的文档配图生成工具，能自动理解任意格式文档内容并生成专业配图。支持三种风格（渐变玻璃卡片、票据风格、矢量插画）和两种比例（16:9/3:4），可生成封面图与内容配图，适用于小红书、推特等社交媒体内容创作。
repos.summary_en: Document Illustrator is an AI-powered tool that intelligently analyzes document content to generate professional illustrations. It supports three visual styles (gradient glass, ticket, vector illustration) and two aspect ratios (16:9/3:4), capable of creating cover images and thematic illustrations for social media platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter.

repos.description: 🏯 Claude Code / Codex skill — transform Chinese architecture, cultural places & travel photos into art-directed editorial posters with GPT Image. 中国古建筑与在地文化照片 → 艺术指导海报
repos.summary_zh: Yingzao 是将中国古建筑、文化场所与旅行照片转为艺术指导编辑海报的 Agent Skill。它通过构图识别、中式排版设计与图像重绘，保护建筑身份锚点，实现文字与主体的深度互动，支持多图融合与视频分镜扩展。
repos.summary_en: Yingzao is an agent skill that transforms Chinese architectural and cultural photos into art-directed editorial posters. It combines composition analysis, Chinese typography design, and image model generation to preserve architectural identity while creating meaningful text-image interactions, with support for multi-image fusion and video storyboard extension.

repos.description: 一个基于 Nuxt.js 3 开发的小红书工具网站，提供图文，视频，评论 浏览与导出
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Nuxt.js 3 构建的小红书工具网站，支持图文视频内容浏览、评论导出及下载功能，集成多代理轮换与本地数据持久化，提供现代化 UI 与完整代理配置，适用于内容采集与数据分析场景。
repos.summary_en: A Nuxt.js 3-based tool for browsing, exporting, and downloading Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) content including images, videos, and comments. Features modern UI, multi-proxy support, local data persistence, and automated browser interactions via Playwright.

repos.description: Twitter Trend Radar
repos.summary_zh: Twitter Trend Radar 是一款实时扫描 Twitter/X 上带有链接且具备传播力推文的反向域名侦察工具。它通过提取
repos.summary_en: Twitter Trend Radar scans X/Twitter in real time for tweets carrying links and traction, then reverse-looks up each domain's registration age and recent traffic to surface emerging products before Google Trends catches up. It uses launch-signal phrase pools, greylisting of major sites, WHOIS age checks, and 3-month traffic bar charts. A zero-dependency local proxy keeps API keys on-device with no build step required.

repos.description: :metro: 即刻 Ⓙ SDK
repos.summary_zh: Jike Metro 🚇 是一个即刻（Jike）平台的 Python SDK，提供用户信息获取、动态浏览、内容发布、收藏管理、评论互动等全套接口，支持流式数据拉取与自动化操作，适用于开发者快速集成即刻生态功能。
repos.summary_en: Jike Metro 🚇 is a Python SDK for the Jike platform, offering comprehensive APIs for user profiles, news feeds, content creation, collections, comments, and interactions. It supports streaming data and automation, enabling developers to integrate Jike's ecosystem efficiently.

repos.description: Bird is a cli for twitter, so your agents can tweet.
repos.summary_zh: Bird 是一款基于命令行界面的 X (Twitter) 客户端，专为自动化脚本和 AI 智能体设计。它支持通过浏览器 Cookie 或 Sweetistics API 进行身份验证，提供发推、回复、读取推文、搜索及查看提及等核心功能，并支持 JSON 格式输出，便于集成到自动化工作流中。
repos.summary_en: Bird is a fast command-line interface for X (Twitter), designed for automation scripts and AI agents. It supports authentication via browser cookies or the Sweetistics API, offering core functionalities like tweeting, replying, reading, searching, and viewing mentions. It also supports JSON output for seamless integration into automated workflows.
